name: Connection States
description: Count of connections by user and state
sql:
SELECT
    usename,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active') AS active,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle') AS idle,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle in transaction') AS idle_in_transaction,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'disabled') AS disabled,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'fastpath function call') AS fastpath_function_call,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'waiting') AS waiting
FROM pg_stat_activity
GROUP BY usename
ORDER BY active DESC;

name: Lock Information
sql:
SELECT
    w.pid       AS waiting_pid,
    w.usename   AS waiting_user,
    left(w.query, 20)     AS waiting_query,
    w.state     AS waiting_state,
    NOW() - w.query_start AS query_age,
    l.locktype,
    l.mode,
    l.relation::regclass AS relation,
    pg_blocking_pids(w.pid) AS blocking_pids
FROM pg_stat_activity w
JOIN pg_locks l ON w.pid = l.pid
WHERE NOT l.granted
ORDER BY w.query_start;

name: Replication Lag
sql:
SELECT
  s.slot_type,
  left(s.slot_name, 20) as slot_name,
  left(r.application_name, 20) as app_name,
  r.state,
  pg_size_pretty(
    pg_wal_lsn_diff(
      pg_current_wal_lsn(),
      COALESCE(r.sent_lsn, s.confirmed_flush_lsn, s.restart_lsn, '0/0'::pg_lsn)
    )
  ) AS publisher_lag,

  -- Consumer lag only when a sender is active
  CASE WHEN r.pid IS NOT NULL THEN
    pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.sent_lsn, r.write_lsn))
  END AS consumer_lag,

  -- Backlog relative to apply/replay if known; else fall back to slot restart_lsn
  pg_size_pretty(
    pg_wal_lsn_diff(
      pg_current_wal_lsn(),
      COALESCE(r.replay_lsn, s.restart_lsn, '0/0'::pg_lsn)
    )
  ) AS backlog_bytes,

  -- Raw sender LSNs (NULL when inactive)
  r.replay_lsn, r.sent_lsn, r.write_lsn, r.flush_lsn

FROM pg_replication_slots AS s
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_replication AS r
  ON r.pid = s.active_pid
ORDER BY s.slot_name;

name: Vacuum Progress
sql:
SELECT
    p.pid,
    LEFT(c.relname,20) AS table_name,
    p.phase,
    p.heap_blks_scanned || '/' || p.heap_blks_total AS heap_blocks,
    p.heap_blks_vacuumed || '/' || p.heap_blks_total AS vacuumed_blocks,
    p.index_vacuum_count AS index_vacuums
FROM
    pg_stat_progress_vacuum p
JOIN
    pg_class c ON p.relid = c.oid;

name: Autovacuum Stats
sql:
SELECT
    left(s.relname,20) AS relname,
    s.n_dead_tup || '/' || s.n_live_tup AS dead_to_live,
    s.vacuum_count AS vacs,
    s.autovacuum_count AS autovacs,
    s.analyze_count AS analyzes,
    s.autoanalyze_count AS autoanalyzes,
    to_char(GREATEST(s.last_vacuum, s.last_autovacuum),'yyyy-mm-dd') AS last_vac,
    to_char(GREATEST(s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze),'yyyy-mm-dd') AS last_analyze,
    age(c.relfrozenxid)      AS xid_age,
    mxid_age(c.relminmxid)   AS mxid_age,
    CASE
        WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) > 1500000000 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) > 1000000000 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS xid_wraparound_risk
FROM pg_stat_user_tables s
JOIN pg_class c ON s.relid = c.oid
ORDER BY age(c.relfrozenxid) DESC;

name: Configuration Settings
sql: SELECT name, setting, unit, category, short_desc FROM pg_settings ORDER BY category, name;

name: Index Creation
description: Show progress of index creation operations
sql: SELECT p.pid, c.relname AS table_name, ic.relname AS index_name, p.phase, p.lockers_done || '/' || p.lockers_total AS locks, p.blocks_done || '/' || p.blocks_total AS blocks, p.tuples_done || '/' || p.tuples_total AS tupes, p.partitions_done || '/' || p.partitions_total AS parts FROM pg_stat_progress_create_index p LEFT JOIN pg_class c  ON p.relid = c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_class ic ON p.index_relid = ic.oid;

name: Table IO Stats
sql: SELECT LEFT(relname, 20) AS relname, heap_blks_read, heap_blks_hit, idx_blks_read, idx_blks_hit, toast_blks_read, toast_blks_hit, tidx_blks_read, tidx_blks_hit FROM  pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY heap_blks_read DESC;

name: Table Replication State
description: The state of logical replication for each table in the public schema
sql: SELECT s.subname AS subscription, r.srsubstate AS table_state, ARRAY_AGG(c.relname ORDER BY c.relname) AS tables FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_subscription_rel r ON r.srrelid = c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_subscription s     ON s.oid = r.srsubid WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','f') GROUP BY s.subname, r.srsubstate ORDER BY s.subname, r.srsubstate;

name: Top Queries
sql: SELECT LEFT(query, 40) AS query, calls, total_exec_time, mean_exec_time, rows, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read, temp_blks_written FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 25;
